fato_historico: 1965: Hurricane Betsy makes its second landfall near New Orleans, leaving 76 dead and $1.42 billion ($10–12 billion in 2005 dollars) in damages, becoming the first hurricane to cause over $1 billion in unadjusted damage.
energia_do_dia: Just as nature experiences powerful shifts that leave lasting impressions, your inner landscape may today be processing deep emotional currents. Even when external situations feel overwhelming, consider that you possess a steady center. It is a good time to channel your natural balance to navigate turbulence, finding beauty and resilience after the passing of any sudden intensity.
frase_do_dia: After every storm, the earth finds a way to bloom with renewed strength.
significado_numero: The number of deep introspection and seeking hidden truths within yourself.
conselho: Trust your inner compass to guide you gracefully through any unexpected emotional weather today.
